preview.title: Card preview

preview.emptyDescription: Pick a class, then tap anyone in the list.

print.title: How it prints
print.description: Pick what your printer can actually do.

sideBySide.label: Side by side
sideBySide.description: Front and back on the same row. Any printer — cut and glue back to back.

duplex.label: Double-sided
duplex.description: Ten a sheet, fronts and backs on separate pages. Needs a duplex printer.

print.duplexTip1: Ten cards to an A4 sheet, butted edge to edge — one cut serves the two cards either side of it.
print.duplexTip2: Fronts and backs alternate as whole pages. Print double sided, flipping on the long edge.
print.sideTip1: Four cards to an A4 sheet, each one's front and back on the same row.
print.sideTip2: Cut around both faces, then glue them back to back. No two-sided printing anywhere.
print.scalingTip: Set scaling to 100%. "Fit to page" shrinks the cards out of standard size.

scan.verifyFailed: This card could not be verified
scan.validStudent: This student is on the current roll.
scan.validStaff: This member of staff is currently employed.
scan.expiredDetail: This card belongs to a previous session. The office must issue a fresh one.
scan.revokedDetail: The office cancelled this card and issued no replacement. Do not admit on it — send them to the office.
scan.replacedDetail: A newer card was issued. Do not admit on this one — send them to the office.
scan.inactiveStudent: This student has been deactivated. Do not admit on this card — send them to the office.
scan.inactiveStaff: This person is no longer active on the staff roll. Send them to the office.
scan.faceCheck: Check the face against the photo. Nothing is recorded by a scan — this only confirms who the card belongs to.

my.downloaded: Your ID card — front and back on one sheet
my.photoDropped: Your photo could not be embedded — this prints with initials.
my.noCardTitle: No ID card is issued for your account
my.noCardBody: Cards are issued to students and staff. If you think this is wrong, ask the school office to check your profile.
my.cancelledWithReason: Recorded reason: {reason}. It will not be accepted at the gate and cannot be downloaded. Ask the school office to issue a new one.
my.cancelledNoReason: It will not be accepted at the gate and cannot be downloaded. Ask the school office to issue a new one.
my.size: Prints at 85.6 × 54 mm — the standard card size.

signature.tooLarge: Signature must be 1 MB or smaller.
signature.saved: Signature saved — it will print on every card.
signature.removed: Signature removed. Cards will print a blank rule.
signature.title: Authorised signatory
signature.description: Printed on the back of every card.
signature.none: No signature — cards print a blank rule to sign by hand
signature.refreshTitle: Fetch the signature again — use this if another admin has just changed it
signature.hint: A PNG with a transparent background prints best. Up to 1 MB. The image is fetched once and reused for the whole print run, so a hundred cards cost one download.

reissue.revokedWithReason: “{reason}” — it is refused at the gate. Issue {next} to give them a working card again.
reissue.revokedNoReason: It is refused at the gate. Issue {next} to give them a working card again.
reissue.revokeWarnTitle: The card stops working and nothing replaces it
reissue.revokeWarnBody: Issue {version} is refused at the gate from the moment you confirm, and {firstName} will have no working card until you issue one. The card disappears from the parent portal and cannot be printed from here.
reissue.revokeUseReplace: Use Replace card instead if they need a new one straight away.
reissue.revokeReasonHint: With no replacement card to explain itself, this reason is the only record of what happened.
reissue.reissueWarnRevoked: A working card is issued in place of the revoked one
reissue.reissueWarnActive: The card they are holding will stop working immediately
reissue.reissueBodyRevoked: Issue {version} stays revoked and keeps its reason. Issue {next} appears on the parent portal and here straight away — print it and hand it over.
reissue.reissueBodyActive: Issue {version} is refused at the gate from the moment you confirm. Issue {next} appears on the parent portal and here straight away — print it and hand it over.
reissue.replaceHint: Kept against the old card, so this is answerable later.
reissue.extendBody: Keeps the current card working past its session. Nothing is reprinted and the QR does not change — the same plastic simply stays valid.
reissue.toastReissued: New card issued (issue {version}). The previous card no longer works.
reissue.toastRevoked: Card revoked. It is refused at the gate from now on — no replacement has been printed.
reissue.toastExtended: Valid until {date} — the same card keeps working.
